Screens captured from a real Claude Code 2.1.322 pane (scratch tmux server, `capture-pane -p -J`, trailing blanks trimmed), 2026-11-10.
idle: empty prompt. typed-input: `half a sentence` in the input line. typed-list: `/mcp reconnect plugin:telegram:telegram` typed, not submitted.
reconnect-ok / reconnect-unknown: after `/mcp reconnect plugin:telegram:telegram` and `/mcp reconnect nosuch` (the transcript above keeps earlier lines).
working: a turn just started (`✽ Actioning…`). after-turn: the turn done.
real-idle-1 / real-idle-2: a real 2.1.322 lead (`--channels plugin:telegram@claude-plugins-official`, scratch tmux socket, fake-token TELEGRAM_STATE_DIR) captured twice, 3 s apart, 2026-11-10: identical, placeholder included. Its telegram server was then killed and `telegram_watch.py --once` logged `reconnect: ok`.
real-ghost-suggestion.ansi / real-typed-text.ansi: `capture-pane -p -e -J -S -12` (SGR kept) of a scratch real 2.1.322 lead (real config dir, scratch socket `-L tgwghost`, fake-token TELEGRAM_STATE_DIR), 2026-11-10. ghost: a turn just ended and Claude drew its prompt suggestion: `❯`, a no-break space, then `ESC[2m` (dim) `run it with a few values` `ESC[0m`. typed: `my typed words` typed after `❯` and the no-break space, no SGR at all.
turn-start-task-label / turn-start-task-label-elapsed / idle-with-teammates: `tmux capture-pane -p -t %8` (no `-J`, trailing blank rows kept) of the real Claude Code 2.1.325 lead pane, 2026-11-14, a lead with an in-progress task and teammates. Source captures run1 epochs 1794710786.616, 1794710788.519, 1794710785.280 (see docs/superpowers/notes/2026-11-15-turn-start-spinner-real-check.md). task-label: the first frame of a turn, the spinner label is the in-progress task's subject (multi-word), a `⎿` task list under it and a column-0 `busy N · ready N … [-]` row before the input rule. task-label-elapsed: 1.7 s later, the same with `(2s · ↓ 7 tokens)` after the label. idle-with-teammates: epoch 1794710785.280, the last frame before the message arrived: no spinner line, the same `busy/ready` row.
turn-wrapped-posttooluse / turn-wrapped-stop-hooks: plain `tmux capture-pane -p -t %8` (no `-J`) of the real Claude Code 2.1.325 lead pane, 111 columns, 2026-11-14, run2 epochs 1794711231.512 and 1794711270.990. Mid-turn frames where the task-label spinner carries a hook suffix and wraps onto two rows: `✢ Plan & run: …design.md… (running PostToolUse hook ·` then `4s · ↓ 9 tokens)` at column 0, and `· Plan & run: …design.md… (running Stop hooks… 0/4 ·` then `2s · ↓ 28 tokens)`. They sit above the task list, `busy/ready` row and input rule.
